title: Myoglobinuria (StatPearls)
claims: Evaluation of dark urine starts with a urine dipstick, which is positive for heme in patients with myoglobinuria.
Microscopic analysis of the urine in myoglobinuria reveals no red blood cells, which points to myoglobin rather than intact red cells.
Myoglobinuria produces a more brownish-coloured urine, while hematuria often causes reddish urine with many red blood cells per high-power field.
The creatine kinase level is much higher in patients with myoglobinuria than in those with hematuria.
